```{r}
#| label: departments_cleaning

clean_df <- function(df) {
  return(df |>
    janitor::clean_names() |>
     mutate(across(everything(), \(x) ifelse(str_detect(x, "\\*|Unknown|Unspecified"), NA, x)))
  )
}

departments <- clean_df(departments_raw) |>
  filter(department_key > 0)
determinants <- clean_df(determinants_raw) 
encounters <- clean_df(encounters_raw) |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date, format = "%m/%d/%y"), visit_type = str_to_title(visit_type))
diagnosis <- clean_df(diagnosis_raw)
patients <- clean_df(patients_raw)
providers <- clean_df(providers_raw) 
tigercensus <- clean_df(tigercensus_raw)
```
